name: Inbox
description: What's waiting across the mailboxes Email Triage watches: how many threads survived triage (Needs you), with how many aren't triaged yet. Small shows the one number; medium adds per-account counts that double as the filter; large adds the top few threads with the reason triage kept them. The accounts are Email Triage's, in its config order, read through the Inbox app's own data layer; tap the number or a thread to open the Inbox.
